tasks.title: Add the open error codes and the header parser for JPEG, PNG/APNG, GIF and the refused formats
tasks.dod: Vitest proves sniffImageHeader returns format, size, animated and orientation for JPEG/PNG/APNG/GIF fixtures, the named UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT for SVG/BMP/ICO/TIFF/RAW/PSD and NOT_AN_IMAGE/UNREADABLE for junk and truncated bytes, never throwing; result.ts carries all eight new codes

tasks.title: Extend the header parser to WebP, AVIF and HEIC/HEIF and add the property/fuzz test
tasks.dod: Vitest proves sniffImageHeader reads WebP (VP8/VP8L/VP8X), AVIF/AVIS and HEIC sizes and animation, returns UNREADABLE for missing ispe or oversized boxes, and the fuzz suite over truncated and mutated samples never throws or hangs

tasks.title: Implement the open policy: size ceiling, Downscale-limit target size, reduction steps and drop-candidate order

tasks.title: Implement the pure View model (Fit, zoom steps, clamp, zoom-at-point, pan clamp, auto-fit) and the Work revision rule

tasks.title: Build the decode worker pipeline and the main-thread decodeImage client with supersede and error mapping
tasks.dod: Vitest proves decodeImage terminates a superseded worker and resolves it as Superseded, terminates on result, passes typed {code, details} errors through, and maps NotReadable/NotFound/Security errors to FILE_NOT_PERMITTED; the worker runs header -> policy -> decode -> stepwise downscale -> transfer

tasks.title: Add the worker's orientation and HEIC capability probes and the EXIF-orientation fallback
tasks.dod: Vitest proves the 8-orientation transform table and that probe results from the first worker are cached and passed to later workers; HEIC decode failure maps to UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT where the probe says unsupported and DECODE_FAILED where it says supported

tasks.title: Add the platform intake: window drop guard, files from a DataTransfer, and the single-file picker

tasks.title: Build the WebGL2 preview renderer: mipmapped Original texture, View transform uniform, DPR sizing, draw-on-change

tasks.title: Handle WebGL context loss: restore from the kept bitmap within the deadline, else report DISPLAY_LOST
tasks.dod: Vitest with fake timers proves the renderer goes restoring -> ready when restored within 5000 ms (re-uploading from the kept bitmap), restoring -> lost after the deadline or on rebuild failure, and ignores late restores

tasks.title: Add the notice queue and the shared UI primitives Spinner, Toast, ToastStack, Dialog and CanvasMessage

tasks.title: Implement the editor store's open and replace rule: latest-open-wins, confirm on Unsaved edits, cancel, and View actions

tasks.title: Add drop sequencing, the messages catalog and the notices raised by each open
